threads.body: [General] This restriction is only added to the javaagent project. `instrumentation/helidon-4.3/library/build.gradle.kts` also declares `library("io.helidon.webserver:helidon-webserver:4.3.0")`; the shared base convention resolves that to the pinned `#+` version in `-PtestLatestDeps=true` builds. The library tests will therefore still load Helidon 27.0.0 on the repository's Java 25 test runtime, so the latest-deps check can fail even though the agent module is constrained. Add the same `latestDepTestLibrary(...:4.+)` override to the library module, or otherwise constrain that module too.
threads.hunk:
@@ -19,6 +19,8 @@ dependencies {
   library("io.helidon.webserver:helidon-webserver:4.3.0")
   implementation(project(":instrumentation:helidon-4.3:library"))
   testImplementation(project(":instrumentation:helidon-4.3:testing"))
+  // 27.0.0 requires java 27, limit the latest dep version for now
+  latestDepTestLibrary("io.helidon.webserver:helidon-webserver:4.+") // documented limitation
